Who bears the adjustment. The single-region rules relabelled by role: the deficit region is the one whose current account the intervention worsens with no rule (North money), for that intervention and intervening region. When the deficit region has to adjust, dual contraction becomes common; when the surplus region adjusts, it does not occur.
